items.name: Readability
items.evidence: This is a two-line change with a clear comment ("# Ensure base table is in aliases.") that explains the side-effecting call. Formatting matches the existing code and the reference solution exactly.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It reuses the existing helper query.get_initial_alias() inside single_alias. Collector and QuerySet.delete are untouched, there is no duplicated logic, and no dead code or debug output was left behind.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: It adds no error-handling surface and no magic constants. get_initial_alias() is idempotent, so calling it when an alias already exists is safe. Hidden tests pass (F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52).

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: The root cause is fixed in single_alias by registering the base alias before counting. The agent checked that joined deletes still use the subquery (e.g. filter(avatar__desc='a') keeps IN (SELECT ... INNER JOIN)). There is no backend-specific branch, and the MySQL compiler inherits the fix.
